note: H1: ground height in the larger World. 'enabled' ships false; anything but a plain true is off, and off means the World is flat exactly as before. 'scale' multiplies every rise (H1 keeps them very low because props still sit at y 0 until H2). Rises are cosine bumps: x, z, radius r and height h in metres. 'feather' is how far the land takes to ease up from a flat zone. Flat zones themselves are in lib/ground.ts.
